
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /theme  (/palette)                         │
  │  Color Theme                                │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Pick the UI color palette.

  Usage:
    /theme
    /theme <name>

  Details:
    Changes RadSim's terminal color palette. Run without arguments
    for an interactive picker, or pass a palette name directly.
    The choice is saved in ~/.radsim/settings.json.

  Examples:
    $ /theme
    $ /palette

  Related: /font  /animations
